metadata.title: आदिवासी को मारता मलेरिया | Malaria Killing Adivasis Every Year | Tribes of Tripura
metadata.description: Malaria remains a significant health crisis in the tribal areas of Tripura, claiming numerous lives annually, particularly among children. Despite the state government's ambitious declaration to eradicate malaria by 2027, the harsh ground reality tells a different story. Our special ground report delves deep into the challenges faced by these vulnerable communities, highlighting the stark contrast between official promises and the ongoing struggles. Through firsthand accounts and expert insights, we uncover the critical gaps in healthcare infrastructure and the persistent threat of this deadly disease. Join us as we explore the urgent need for effective interventions and sustainable solutions.
